Class PlayerStatsDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.PlayerStatsDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerStatsDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Carries the current numerical statistics for a single player.

Sent by the server whenever a player's score or food count changes.
